lines.en: label imanispecial1:
scene hangoutsesh1
: Senpai! It’s me! Imani! Your bubbly and lovable assistant!
lines.zh: : Senpai!是我!Imani!你活力满满、人见人爱的助教!

lines.en: : Why are you yelling? And why are you on the other side of the door?
lines.zh: : 你嚷什么?还有你为什么在门外?

lines.en: : I have a proposal for you!
lines.zh: : 我有一个提议!

lines.en: : You want to get married?
lines.zh: : 你是想结婚?

lines.en: : One day, sure! But I’d appreciate it if you’d let me tell you my idea first before we make any rash decisions!
lines.zh: : 总有一天会的!但我希望你能先听我讲完我的点子,再做任何草率的决定!

lines.en: : Imani, just open the door.
lines.zh: : Imani,你先开门。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh2
: Thank you, Senpai. I think my yelling was starting to give Wakana a migraine.
lines.zh: : 谢谢,Senpai。我觉得我刚才的嚷嚷已经快把 Wakana 弄出偏头痛了。

lines.en: : Waking up gives me a migraine. As does talking. And walking. And pretty much everything else now that I’m approaching 30.
lines.zh: : 醒着就让我偏头痛。说话也是。走路也是。还有眼下几乎一切——毕竟我快三十了。

lines.en: : Is Wakana in on this “proposal” as well? Or is this just an “us” thing?
lines.zh: : Wakana 也参与这场「提议」吗?还是这是「我们俩」的事?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh3
: Hah...Senpai, can’t you ever be happy with me alone?
lines.zh: : 哈……Senpai,你就不能为我一个人高兴一次吗?

lines.en: : Just once, I would like a night where the two of us can really let ourselves loose without you enlisting the help of another girl. It really hurts my self-esteem when you do things like that, you know.
lines.zh: : 哪怕只有一个晚上,我也希望只有我们俩真正放得开,不用你再去拉拢别的女孩。你干那种事,真的很伤我的自尊,你知道吗。

lines.en: : But there you go again- cornering me with your insatiable desires the same way you always do.
lines.zh: : 可你又来了——用你贪得无厌的欲望把我逼到墙角,一如既往。

lines.en: : You too?
lines.zh: : 你也这样?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh4
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等,什么?

lines.en: : When did your interest shift from students to teachers, Arakawa? If something monumental happened in your life, it’s only right that you share it with your closest, most trusted associates.
lines.zh: : 你的兴趣什么时候从学生转到了老师身上,Akira?要是你的人生发生了什么大事,和你最亲近、最信任的人分享,才是正理。

lines.en: : I...didn’t mean for that to happen.
lines.zh: : 我……没打算让它发生。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh5
: Mean for what to happen?! How come nobody ever talks to me?!
lines.zh: : 打算让什么发生?!为什么没人跟我说话?!

lines.en: : Because you’re loud. Now, out with your “proposal.” Which should technically be a “proposition,” but still.
lines.zh: : 因为你嗓门大。好,说说你的「提议」。严格来说那应该是「proposition(提案)」,但无所谓。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh6
: Fine! But only because doing so will open the door for you two to tell me later when we are all tipsy and have to hold ourselves back from kissing each other.
lines.zh: : 好!但我只因为——说出来,才能为你们俩以后「喝到微醺、彼此亲热又要拼命忍住」的时候向我坦白,铺平道路!

lines.en: : Whatever it is, I’m in.
lines.zh: : 无论是什么,我加入。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh7
: Hell yeah! That’s the pervert I know and love!
lines.zh: : 好极了!这才是我认识又深爱的那个变态!

lines.en: : What you two do on your own time is in no way tied to me. I agree to the former of those two ideas and have no problem going out to drink, but I will be kissing no one until my partner arrives.
lines.zh: : 你们俩私下做什么,和我毫无关系。两个主意里我同意前者——出去喝酒我没问题——但在我的伴侣到来之前,我谁也不亲。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh8
: Can we watch once she does?
lines.zh: : 她到了之后,我们能围观吗?

lines.en: : You? Maybe. Arakawa? No. He has a bad track record.
lines.zh: : 你?也许。Arakawa?不行。他的前科太差。

lines.en: : Seriously, what happened with you two?
lines.zh: : 认真的,你们俩到底怎么了?

lines.en: : Are we going to a bar or something? Is that what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 我们是要去酒吧之类的吗?是这么回事吗?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh9
: I believe that is Imani’s plan, yes.
lines.zh: : 我想那是 Imani 的计划,没错。

lines.en: : Us three and Wakana’s woman. I think she’s gonna be a little late because of work, though. You in?
lines.zh: : 我们仨,加上 Wakana 的女人。不过她因为工作大概会晚点到。你加入吗?

lines.en: : Wouldn’t that technically make this a double date?
lines.zh: : 那严格来说,这不就成了四人双约会?

lines.en: : Depends on where our pants end up, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那得看我们的裤子最后落在哪了,我猜。

lines.en: : How nostalgic. It wasn’t all that long ago that we had our first double date, Arakawa. You and that...peculiar girl...Makinami, was it?
lines.zh: : 多么怀旧。距离我们第一次双约会,并没有过去多久,Arakawa。你和那个……古怪的姑娘……Makinami,是叫这个吧?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh10
: You went on a date with Maya?! But I thought you were supposed to marry Noriko?! Those two hate each other! What will the tabloids say?!
lines.zh: : 你和 Maya 约过会?!可你不是要娶 Noriko 吗?!她们俩互相看不顺眼!小报会怎么写?!

lines.en: : Wakana, you’re creating a lot of problems for me today by just existing.
lines.zh: : Wakana,你今天光凭「存在」就给我制造了大量麻烦。

lines.en: : I am, aren’t I? It’s actually quite fun.
lines.zh: : 我是有这个效果,不是吗?其实还挺好玩。

lines.en: : Well, whatever. Sure. I’ll go.
lines.zh: : 嗯,随便吧。行。我去。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh11

: Great! But, just so we’re all in the clear, don’t go bringing Maya or Noriko or any other girl who isn’t legally allowed to drink. This is a getaway for us adults to celebrate another successful week of...
lines.zh: : 太好了!不过先把话说清楚——别把 Maya、Noriko、或任何法律上不允许喝酒的女孩带来。这是我们成年人的欢庆之旅,庆祝又成功度过了一周的……

lines.en: : Well, being adults. That shit is hard, yo.
lines.zh: : 嗯,身为成年人。那玩意很苦,哟。

lines.en: : You cool to meet us there in like...two hours, Senpai? Torn between Sakaki-bar-a and this new place we found on the outskirts of the old district.
lines.zh: : 你两小时后直接到那边和我们碰头,没问题吧,Senpai?我还在 Sakaki 酒吧和旧城区边缘找到的新店之间纠结。

lines.en: : I choose the second place.
lines.zh: : 我选第二家。

lines.en: : Reason being?
lines.zh: : 理由?

lines.en: : The owner of that place doesn’t want to marry me.
lines.zh: : 那家店的老板不想娶我。

lines.en: : Fair enough!
lines.zh: : 合理!

lines.en: scene black
: Come on, Wakana! We can go relax at the spa until Senpai is done giving himself calluses from all that paperwork he has to do while we wait for Makoto to come back!
lines.zh: : 走吧,Wakana!我们去水疗馆放松,等 Senpai 处理完那些把他手上磨出茧的文书,顺便等 Makoto 回来!

lines.en: : You can go on ahead and I’ll meet you there when the time comes. I’m not much of a spa person.
lines.zh: : 你先去,到时候我和你在那边汇合。我不是水疗型选手。

lines.en: : Tch. No wonder if you’ve got those bags beneath your eyes. You really need to lighten up, girl.
lines.zh: : 啧。难怪你眼睛底下挂着黑眼圈。你真该放松放松,姑娘。

lines.en: : Come on! I’ll-
lines.zh: : 来嘛!我会——

lines.en: : Touch me and I will make a necklace out of your skull.
lines.zh: : 敢碰我,我就用你的颅骨串一条项链。

lines.en: Imani and Wakana exit the office and...I guess I have plans to go out with them tonight.
lines.zh: Imani 和 Wakana 走出办公室,然后……我猜我今晚有安排了。

lines.en: As I lean back in my chair and take in this thought like a breath of fresh air, I realize how far I’ve come.
lines.zh: 我靠回椅背,像呼吸一口新鲜空气那样消化这个念头,并意识到自己已经走了多远。

lines.en: If you’d have told me several apocalypses ago that I’d be one day going out for drinks with friends from work, I-
lines.zh: 要是你在几个世界末日之前告诉我,有朝一日我会和同事出去喝酒,我——

lines.en: Well I probably wouldn’t have answered you at all because I’d be too busy having sex with Ayane or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我多半根本不会理你——因为我正忙着和 Ayane 做爱什么的。

lines.en: But now, I can’t have sex with Ayane. And I can go out for drinks with friends from work.
lines.zh: 但现在,我不能再和 Ayane 做爱了。而我,可以和同事出去喝酒了。

lines.en: And that’s...
lines.zh: 而这……

lines.en: I think that’s...
lines.zh: 我觉得这……

lines.en: Good for me?
lines.zh: : 对我算是好事?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh12
: ...and that’s exactly why I think Sensei’s approach to teaching isn’t entirely bad! Just a little unorthodox! And I can’t imagine it being officially endorsed by anyone any time soon.
lines.zh: : ……正因如此,我才觉得 Sensei 的教学方式不算太糟!只是有点非主流!而我也想象不出,短期内会有谁正式给它背书。

lines.en: : You’ve corrupted her, Arakawa. This young, aspiring educator is now sticking up for you when all you do is ruin the lives of everyone you encounter.
lines.zh: : 你把她带坏了,Arakawa。这位年轻有志的教育工作者,现在居然在替你说话——而你做的唯一一件事,就是毁掉你遇到的每一个人的人生。

lines.en: : Hey, my life isn’t that bad! Thanks to Sensei’s shortcomings, I now have a stable job and was able to put a down payment on a new apartment the other day! I really owe a lot to him.
lines.zh: : 嘿,我的人生没那么糟!多亏 Sensei 的失职,我现在有了稳定的工作,前几天还给新公寓付了首付!我亏欠他良多。

lines.en: : Did you hear that, Arakawa? Your shortcomings helped Imani move out of the spa. I think you might finally be due for an AATJ award.
lines.zh: : 听到了吗,Arakawa?你的失职帮 Imani 搬出了桑拿房。我想,你终于可以领一个 AATJ 奖了。

lines.en: : I don’t even know what that is.
lines.zh: : 我连那是什么都不知道。

lines.en: : Why am I not surprised?
lines.zh: : 我一点也不意外。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh13
: For real, though. I think we make a good team, Senpai. I do all the actual teaching, and you just hang around and motivate all of the girls by being handsome and whatnot. It’s working pretty well.
lines.zh: : 说正经的。我觉得我们组了个好团队,Senpai。真正教学的我来干,你只要四处晃,靠脸和其他什么给女孩们打打气。运转得相当顺利。

lines.en: : I also think you two go well together. But that’s only because you’re both so obnoxious that you seem to almost cancel each other out.
lines.zh: : 我也觉得你们俩很般配。但那只是因为你们俩都烦人到几乎互相抵消。

lines.en: : I think our double date is officially a success. Wakana has formally endorsed us as a couple.
lines.zh: : 我想,我们的双约会正式宣告成功。Wakana 已经以官方身份承认我们是情侣。

lines.en: : Speaking of which, when’s Osako going to show up? Wasn’t she supposed to be out by now?
lines.zh: : 说起来,Osako 什么时候到?她不是早该下班了吗?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh14
: She’ll get here when she gets here. The way business fluctuates at that cafe would make you think it’s situated inside of a subway station.
lines.zh: : 她能来就来。那家咖啡厅的生意起伏,会让你以为它开在地铁站里。

lines.en: : But, please. Don’t let the absence of my partner dissuade you two from incessantly flirting with one another.
lines.zh: : 不过,请便。别因为我的伴侣缺席,就停下你们没完没了的调情。

lines.en: : Just know, Imani, that you may be pushed against a wall at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 只要知道,Imani,你随时可能被按到墙上。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh15
: Hah...
: Is that what happened with you guys? Senpai tried to make a move? Got a little too handsy?
lines.zh: : 你们俩也是这样吗?Senpai 主动出手了?动手动脚了?

lines.en: : A momentary lapse in judgement, I suppose. I apparently have that effect on people.
lines.zh: : 一次短暂的判断失误,我猜。看来我对人就有这种效果。

lines.en: : I still have no clue why Osako was so smitten by me, so it’s plausible that Arakawa caught the same bug and now can no longer look at me without wanting to take me into his arms.
lines.zh: : 我至今仍不明白 Osako 为什么被我迷住,所以说得通的解释是,Arakawa 也染上了同款病毒,如今不把我抱进怀里就受不了。

lines.en: : That’s...not what happened.
lines.zh: : 那……不是事情的原委。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh16
: Relax. I’m only kidding.
lines.zh: : 放松。我只是开玩笑。

lines.en: : One more strike and you’re out, though. I can only forgive you so many times before I’m forced to rethink some of the decisions I’ve made.
lines.zh: : 不过,再犯一次你就出局了。我能原谅你的次数有限,超过之后,我就不得不重新审视我做过的某些决定。

lines.en: : I’m assuming the first strike was the hospital?
lines.zh: : 我猜第一次,是医院那回?

lines.en: : I will never let you live that down.
lines.zh: : 那件事我永远会让你记着。

lines.en: : Hospital? That’s when...I was first hired, right? To cover for you?
lines.zh: : 医院?那是……我第一次被雇来的时候吧?替你代课?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh17
: Why are you asking me? I was unconscious the majority of the time.
lines.zh: : 你问我干什么?那段时间的大部分我都在昏迷。

lines.en: : You’re cool now, though...right? No terminal illnesses I have to worry about or anything?
lines.zh: : 但你现在没事了……对吧?没有什么绝症需要我担心之类的?

lines.en: : Not unless one of the two parasites accompanying me at this table tonight decides to infect me.
lines.zh: : 除非今晚陪我坐在这一桌的两只寄生虫里,有一只决定感染我。

lines.en: : I’ve got no plans to infect you. Not sure about Senpai, though- since he apparently can’t hold himself back anymore.
lines.zh: : 我没有感染你的计划。Senpai 就不确定了——毕竟他显然已经管不住自己了。

lines.en: : I’m just going to wait until this slandering of my name is done to jump back into the conversation.
lines.zh: : 我就等你们诽谤完了,再重新加入对话。

lines.en: : Is it really slander if it’s the truth?
lines.zh: : 如果说的是真相,还算诽谤吗?

lines.en: : I’d answer, but I’m still not done waiting.
lines.zh: : 我本想回答,但我还在等。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh18
: Then, for the sake of including Senpai again, how about we play a game?!
lines.zh: : 那么,为了把 Senpai 也拉回来,我们不如玩个游戏?!

lines.en: : It’s the first of many times we’ll all be hanging out after work, so we should probably start some kinda...fun tradition. Right? And what's more fun than a cool, adult game?!
lines.zh: : 这是我们第一次下班后聚会,以后还会有很多次,所以我们大概该开启某种……有趣的传统。对吧?还有什么比一个酷炫的成人游戏更好玩?!

lines.en: : I don’t know if I have the energy to do this as often as you want to.
lines.zh: : 我不知道我有没有精力按你想的频率玩这个。

lines.en: : Then how about once a week? On...Fridays or something. We don’t have to always go, but it’d be cool if there was a place we could all meet up.
lines.zh: : 那一周一次怎么样?在……周五什么的。我们不必每次都来,但有个大家都能碰头的地方,挺好的。

lines.en: : Just...something to look forward to, you know?
lines.zh: : 就是……有个盼头,你知道吧?

lines.en: : Works for me. Can’t guarantee I’ll always be here, but I’ll keep it in mind.
lines.zh: : 我可以。不能保证我每次都到,但我会记在心里。

lines.en: : I suppose I’m in the same boat as Arakawa. I’m still on the fence about this “game” though. Drinking games aren’t exactly my cup of tea.
lines.zh: : 我想我和 Arakawa 在同一条船上。不过对这场「游戏」我仍持观望态度。喝酒游戏不对我胃口。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh19
: You’ve had like thirteen beers already.
lines.zh: : 你已经喝了十三杯了。

lines.en: : Either I am very drunk or you are very bad at counting, as I only see five.
lines.zh: : 要么我醉得很,要么你不会数数——我只看到五杯。

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be a drinking game. How about something we can play to...get to know each other a little better? Like twenty questions? Two truths and a lie? Truth or dare? Any of that shit?
lines.zh: : 不一定要喝酒游戏。玩点能……让我们更了解彼此的怎么样?二十个问题?两个真话一个谎?真心话大冒险?随便哪个?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh20
: That sounds exhausting.
lines.zh: : 听着就累。

lines.en: : I’ll do whatever. I don’t really care.
lines.zh: : 随便。我无所谓。

lines.en: : Wow. You two are real party animals, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哇。你们俩真是派对动物啊。

lines.en: : This may come as a bit of a shock, but I’m actually not.
lines.zh: : 这也许出乎意料,但我其实不是。

lines.en: : I can party.
lines.zh: : 我能嗨。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh21
: Spoken like the true table elder, Senpai. Just what am I going to do with you?
lines.zh: : 一听就是真正的一桌之长才说的话,Senpai。我拿你怎么办呢?

lines.en: : I didn’t realize I was yours to use.
lines.zh: : 我可没意识到我是「归你用」的。

lines.en: : Well, it’s no fair if you only get to use me all the time. I want to have a little fun too, you know?
lines.zh: : 嗯,只准你用我、不准我用你,多不公平。我也想找点乐子,知道吗?

lines.en: : Leave it to a man to only care about pleasuring himself. This is why I’m dating a woman.
lines.zh: : 果然是男人,只在乎自己爽。这就是为什么我在和女人约会。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh22
: Oh no. I’m suddenly busy on every Friday for the indefinite future. How disappointing.
lines.zh: : 哦,糟了。我突然在未来无限长的时间里,每个周五都有事。真遗憾。

lines.en: : You know what we need? Another person less like you guys and more like me! Another shepherd to herd you lazy sheep and whip you into social mode!
lines.zh: : 你知道我们需要什么吗?一个不那么像你们、而更像我的新人!再加一个牧羊人,把你们这群懒羊赶进社交模式!

lines.en: : I’m typically the one who does the whipping, but I see where you’re coming from.
lines.zh: : 通常动鞭子的是我,不过我明白你的意思。

lines.en: : I’ll call Osako and see how long it will be until she’s here, but-
lines.zh: : 我去打给 Osako,看看她还要多久到,但是——

lines.en: : Screw Osako!
lines.zh: : 去他的 Osako!

lines.en: : I do. Quite frequently, at that.
lines.zh: : 我确实去干她。而且频率相当高。

lines.en: : Not what I meant! Every second of every day, we come closer to death’s door! We need to savor this time, Wakana! We can’t just spend our whole lives waiting for the next thing to happen!
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思!每一天的每一秒,我们都在逼近死亡的门口!我们得珍惜当下,Wakana!我们不能把整个人生都耗在等待下一件事发生上!

lines.en: : Sometimes, what we need to do is make things happen ourselves!
lines.zh: : 有时候,我们该做的就是亲手让事情发生!

lines.en: : I feel another proposal coming on.
lines.zh: : 我感觉又一个提议要来了。

lines.en: : We need adventure!
lines.zh: : 我们需要冒险!

lines.en: : We need excitement!
lines.zh: : 我们需要刺激!

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh23
: We need that hottie over there with all of the tattoos to join our friend group!
lines.zh: : 我们需要那边那个满身纹身的辣妹加入我们的朋友圈!

lines.en: : You are too outgoing and it makes me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 你外向得让人不自在。

lines.en: : I suppose every group needs its extrovert, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,每个团体大概都需要一个外向担当。

lines.en: : I concur that, from here, she looks very attractive. But I don’t think you can just walk up to someone and-
lines.zh: : 我同意,从这里看,她确实很有魅力。但我不认为你可以直接走上前去——

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh24
: Hi!
lines.zh: : 你好!

lines.en: : Welp, there she goes.
lines.zh: : 好嘛,她去了。

lines.en: : Great. Now my beer is talking to me. Just what I needed.
lines.zh: : 太好了。现在我的啤酒开始和我说话了。正是我需要的。

lines.en: : Not beer! A real, live human. Typically non-alcoholic, but I will admit that I have had a few to drink tonight.
lines.zh: : 不是啤酒!是一个活的真人。通常不含酒精,但我承认我今晚喝了几杯。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh25
: You’re talking to me, right? Not the beer?
lines.zh: : 你是在和我说话,对吧?不是对啤酒?

lines.en: : Something wrong? Seem a little down in the dumps.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了?你看起来有点失落。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh26
: My life is over.
lines.zh: : 我的人生完了。

lines.en: : Well, it doesn’t have to be. Does it?
lines.zh: : 嗯,它未必要完。对吧?

lines.en: : I’m not good at riddles. Just tell me what you want and I’ll pretend to know what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长猜谜。直接说你想干什么,我会假装听懂。

lines.en: : My friends at that table over there and I were just about to play a little game, but it wouldn’t be as fun without a fourth player. So I was wondering if you’d maybe want to join us?
lines.zh: : 那边那桌的朋友和我正要玩个小游戏,但没有第四个人,玩起来没意思。所以我想问,你要不要加入我们?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh27
: Join you? Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 加入你们?你确定?

lines.en: : Do you not want to?
lines.zh: : 你不想吗?

lines.en: : I...have no clue who you even are. And I’m also caught in a cycle where I break into tears every five minutes. So unless your game involves crying, I should probably stay over here.
lines.zh: : 我……完全不知道你是谁。而且我正陷在一个每五分钟哭一轮的循环里。所以除非你们的游戏带哭的,我大概该待在这儿。

lines.en: : I think you should come with me. I could really use a partner, you know.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你该跟我走。我真的很需要一个搭档,你知道吗。

lines.en: : I’m not very good at trivia.
lines.zh: : 我不擅长问答赛。

lines.en: : Just get off the stool and follow me, damn it. It’s painful seeing you all alone over here.
lines.zh: : 从凳子上下来跟我走,该死的。看你一个人坐在这,太让人心疼了。

lines.en: scene black
scene hangoutsesh28
: There we go! One order of adventure and excitement delivered, courtesy of Imani Imai. You can thank me later once she’s a vital part of our team.
lines.zh: : 搞定!一份「冒险与刺激」已送达——由 Imani Imai 倾情提供。等她成为我们团队不可或缺的一员,你们记得谢我。

lines.en: : I feel like a puppy just dropped a toy at my feet and expects me to...play with it or something.
lines.zh: : 我感觉自己像被人扔了一脚边的玩具狗,然后它指望我……陪它玩之类的。

lines.en: : That is what you are supposed to do with puppies, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯,对待小狗,本来就该这么办,我猜。

lines.en: : I had a dog once.
lines.zh: : 我以前养过一条狗。

lines.en: : He was murdered.
lines.zh: : 它被谋杀了。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh29
: Ahh, yes. I can feel the excitement already.
lines.zh: : 啊,对。我已经感受到「冒险与刺激」了。

lines.en: : Uhh...maybe lay back on some of the puppy murder and...start by introducing yourself? I’m Imani, the tired one is Wakana- not terminally ill, by the way. And the man is just Senpai.
lines.zh: : 呃……要不先收着点你的杀狗言论,然后……先自我介绍一下?我是 Imani,那个累瘫的是 Wakana——顺便说一句,不是绝症。这位就是 Senpai。

lines.en: : Or...Sensei to most people.
lines.zh: : 或者……对大多数人来说,Sensei。

lines.en: : Do you teach karate?
lines.zh: : 你教空手道吗?

lines.en: : No?
lines.zh: : 不是?

lines.en: : Fuck. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 糟。抱歉。

lines.en: : I like to guess people’s jobs the first time I meet them and you gave me karate vibes.
lines.zh: : 我第一次见人喜欢猜对方的职业,而你给了我空手道的感觉。

lines.en: : My girlfriend teaches karate. Perhaps you smelled it lingering on my clothes?
lines.zh: : 我的女朋友教空手道。也许是衣服上残留的味道被你闻到了?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh30
: WAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 呜啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!

lines.en: : I think your new friend is broken, Imani.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的新朋友坏了,Imani。

lines.en: : Hey, hey, hey. Don’t cry yet! You haven’t even told us your name. How are we supposed to cheer you up if we don’t even know that?
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿。先别哭!你还没告诉我们你的名字。连这个都不知道,我们怎么哄你?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh31
: I’m sorry. It’s been five minutes.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。才过了五分钟。

lines.en: : It’s been what?
lines.zh: : 过了什么?

lines.en: : Part of the cycle, Wakana. Come on. Leave whatsername alone.
lines.zh: : 周期的一部分,Wakana。来吧。别管那个什么名字的人了。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh32
: It’s Rika. Nice to meet all of you and sorry for crying within the first five things I said.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Rika。很高兴认识你们,为我在开场五句话之内就哭而抱歉。

lines.en: : Welcome to the table. We’ll be here every Friday from now on. Well, unless we’re not.
lines.zh: : 欢迎入席。从今往后每个周五,我们都会在这里。嗯,除非不来。

lines.en: : Are you part of a...club or something?
lines.zh: : 你是某个……社团的吗?

lines.en: : We’re all teachers, actually. This is our new after-work ritual.
lines.zh: : 其实我们都是老师。这是我们新的下班仪式。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh33
: That’s awesome! I’m glad it’s something like that and not karate. I know a lot more about teachers than I know about karate people.
lines.zh: : 太棒了!幸好是这个而不是空手道。比起空手道圈的人,我对老师圈的了解多多了。

lines.en: : I still think she’s broken.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得她坏了。

lines.en: : I’m with Arakawa on this. Even if he secretly loves me.
lines.zh: : 这次我站 Arakawa。哪怕他偷偷爱着我。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh30
: AAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊!!!!!!!!

lines.en: : Rika. Bad. Stop it.
lines.zh: : Rika。不行。住手。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh31
: The times between my tears are getting shorter! That was nowhere near five minutes!
lines.zh: : 我两次哭泣之间的间隔越来越短了!那根本不到五分钟!

lines.en: : There there, new buddy. We’ll get your mind off of whatever it is that’s plaguing you in just a sec.
lines.zh: : 好了好了,新伙伴。一秒钟之后,我们就把折磨你的那件事从你脑子里赶出去。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh32
: Sorry again. I suck.
lines.zh: : 再次抱歉。我很逊。

lines.en: : I think I’m good for now, though. I’m pretty sure I’ve run out of tears.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得我暂时没事了。我很确定我的眼泪已经流干了。

lines.en: : If you’re lucky, they’ll never come back. That happened to me one day and I haven’t ever cried since. I suppose I don’t feel much of anything anymore, though.
lines.zh: : 你要是走运,它们就再也不会来了。有一天我身上就发生过这种事,从那以后我再也没哭过。不过大概,我也几乎什么都感觉不到了。

lines.en: : Did you...used to cry a lot or something? Is that why your eyes look like that?
lines.zh: : 你以前……经常哭什么的吗?你的眼睛才长那样?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh34
: That’s just how they look. It’s not really the result of any one thing, I don’t think.
lines.zh: : 它们天生就这样。我觉得并不是某件事的结果。

lines.en: : Huh. Weird. But also kind of cool. You’re like a...hot zombie or something.
lines.zh: : 哈。怪。但也有点酷。你就像一个……性感僵尸什么的。

lines.en: : Thank you. That’s exactly the type of look I’m going for.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。那正是我追求的造型。

lines.en: : So, Rika- we were torn between three games. Twenty-
lines.zh: : 那么,Rika——我们纠结在三个游戏之间。二十个——

lines.en: : I want to play Yahtzee.
lines.zh: : 我想玩骰子游戏。

lines.en: : Twenty questions, truth or dare, or two truths and lie. None of which are Yahtzee.
lines.zh: : 二十个问题、真心话大冒险、或两个真话一个谎。没有一个是骰子游戏。

lines.en: : I guess...if I had to choose out of those three...truth or dare?
lines.zh: : 我猜……非要选的话……真心话大冒险?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh35
: Then it is settled! Our newest friend has chosen the game we will play! And so we will start with her!
lines.zh: : 那就这么定了!我们最新的朋友选定了游戏!那就从她开始!

lines.en: : Rika, select any one of us and force us to confront our fate!
lines.zh: : Rika,任选我们中的一员,逼迫我们直面自己的命运!

lines.en: : Then, uhh...
lines.zh: : 那么,呃……

lines.en: : Wakana. Truth or dare?
lines.zh: : Wakana。真心话还是大冒险?

lines.en: : Truth, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 真心话吧,我想。

lines.en: : If you and your girlfriend ever got into a fight and you knew that you were in the wrong but you loved her anyway and wanted her to stay and were sorry for what you did, what would you do to get her back?
lines.zh: : 如果你和你的女朋友吵架了,你明知道错在你,却仍然爱她、想让她留下、为做过的事抱歉——你会做什么把她追回来?

lines.en: : Also, what would you do when that plan fails? Not just once but three times. And also, how would you hide that from your daughter? Oh, and-
lines.zh: : 另外,那个计划失败的时候——不止失败一次,而是三次——你会怎么办?还有,你会怎么对你的女儿隐瞒?哦,还有——

lines.en: : I am no expert at this game, but I believe that it’s only supposed to be one question.
lines.zh: : 我不是这个游戏的专家,但我觉得规则是一次只许问一个问题。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh36
: Then...just the first part I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……就第一个问题吧,我猜。

lines.en: : Hmm...
: I suppose I’d just be honest with her.
lines.zh: : 我猜,我会对她坦诚。

lines.en: : I believe that if two people are meant to be, they’ll be able to work through their differences and-
lines.zh: : 我相信,如果两个人命中注定,他们就能化解彼此的分歧,然后——

lines.en: : It’s coming. I can feel it.
lines.zh: : 要来了。我感觉得到。

lines.en: : Hold it in, Rika. Hold it in.
lines.zh: : 忍住,Rika。忍住。

lines.en: : Please........proceed......
: I’m...not sure if I want to anymore.
lines.zh: : 我……不确定我还想不想继续了。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh37
: Then I guess Rika’s turn is over! Wakana, you go!
lines.zh: : 那么,我猜 Rika 的回合结束了!Wakana,该你了!

lines.en: : Arakawa. Truth or-
lines.zh: : Arakawa。真心话或——

lines.en: : Dare.
lines.zh: : 大冒险。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh38
: No hesitation at all. Bold.
lines.zh: : 一点犹豫都没有。有胆量。

lines.en: : I’m more afraid of what you’d ask me to tell the truth about than whatever you’ll dare me to do.
lines.zh: : 我更害怕你们让我坦白的真相,而不是你们让我做的大冒险。

lines.en: : In that case...
lines.zh: : 那样的话……

lines.en: : I dare you to submit something for the school’s poetry contest. Under a pseudonym of course.
lines.zh: : 我大冒险你,给学校的诗歌比赛投稿。当然,用笔名。

lines.en: : You can dare me to do literally anything...and that’s what you choose?
lines.zh: : 你可以让我大冒险任何事……而你选了这个?

lines.en: : It’s what I want.
lines.zh: : 这是我想要的。

lines.en: : But why?
lines.zh: : 但为什么?

lines.en: : Sorry, is it your turn now? Because I don’t think you have the right to be asking me for truths when there is a process we must abide by.
lines.zh: : 抱歉,现在轮到你了吗?因为我觉得,在我们必须遵守流程的时候,你还没资格向我讨真心话。

lines.en: : Fine. Since it’s my turn now, truth or-
lines.zh: : 好。既然轮到我了,真心话或——

lines.en: : Dare.
lines.zh: : 大冒险。

lines.en: : Fuck.
lines.zh: : 该死。

lines.en: : You’re an idiot if you didn’t see that coming.
lines.zh: : 你要是没料到这一手,你就是白痴。

lines.en: : It’s so cute when they fight, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 他们吵架的样子真可爱,不是吗?

lines.en: : I dare you to never say anything mean to me ever again.
lines.zh: : 我大冒险你,永远不许再对我说刻薄的话。

lines.en: : Wow. That wasn’t sexual at all. I’m surprised.
lines.zh: : 哇。这一点也不涉及色情。我惊讶了。

lines.en: : I’ve learned my lesson.
lines.zh: : 我吸取教训了。

lines.en: : Will the rest of the night suffice? I think I may be able to manage that much. The rest of eternity? Absolutely not. I enjoy insulting you far too much.
lines.zh: : 今晚剩下的时间够吗?我想我可以做到。至于永远的永远?绝对不行。损你的乐趣我戒不掉。

lines.en: : Fine. But only if you say one nice thing about me right now.
lines.zh: : 行。但前提是你现在说一句我的好话。

lines.en: : Here are two. I value your friendship and I’m proud that you seem to have taken our previous run-in to heart in not demanding anything perverse out of me.
lines.zh: : 给你两句。我珍视你的友情;而且我骄傲地看到,上次交锋之后你似乎把话听了进去,没有再对我提出任何下流的要求。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh39
: That said, I would like to use my next turn to dare Imani to make out with Rika.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此,我想用我的下一个回合,大冒险 Imani 亲 Rika。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh40
: Bro! You didn’t even give me the chance to choose!
lines.zh: : 哥!你连选择的机会都没给我!

lines.en: : Fine. Imani, truth or dare.
lines.zh: : 好。Imani,真心话或大冒险。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh41
: I’m going to count this as a third nice thing you’re doing for me tonight, Wakana.
lines.zh: : Wakana,我要把这件事算作你今晚为我做的第三件好事。

lines.en: : Arakawa, I am doing this for myself.
lines.zh: : Arakawa,我做这个是为了我自己。

lines.en: : Please never forget that beneath my broody exterior, I am in a very sexually active relationship with a woman I adore.
lines.zh: : 请永远不要忘记,在我阴郁的外表之下,我和一位我深爱的女性,保持着非常活跃的性关系。

lines.en: : Also, alcohol has certain adverse effects on me and I believe our new “friend” may need this.
lines.zh: : 另外,酒精对我有某些副作用,而且我觉得我们的新「朋友」也许需要这个。

lines.en: : Uhh...
: Jesus Christ, Imani. Weren’t you just ranting a short while ago about how we’re wasting away our lives due to inactivity?
lines.zh: : 我的老天,Imani。你不久前不是还在咆哮,说我们正因为无所作为在浪费人生吗?

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh42
: Well, yeah! But that was before you dared me to make out with a girl I just met!
lines.zh: : 嗯,是!但那是在你让我亲一个刚认识五分钟的女孩之前!

lines.en: : Also, I was kind of hoping Rika would give me some sort of cue instead of just blankly staring at me!
lines.zh: : 还有,我本来有点盼着 Rika 给我个信号,而不是干瞪着我!

lines.en: : I’d make out with you.
lines.zh: : 我愿意和你亲。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh43
: Oh. Then fuck yeah, dare.
lines.zh: : 哦。那太好了,大冒险,成交。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh44
: Mn~
: Mmf.......mnn!
lines.zh: : 姆夫………嗯嗯!

lines.en: : Wow.
scene hangoutsesh45
: I lied. I am an expert at this game. Osako and I played constantly in college...though, always alone.
lines.zh: : 我撒谎了。我其实是这个游戏的专家。我和 Osako 在大学里常玩……只不过,总是一个人玩。

lines.en: : That just sounds sad.
lines.zh: : 听着就好悲。

lines.en: : It’s how I learned she likes being handcuffed.
lines.zh: : 我就是这样知道她喜欢被铐起来的。

lines.en: : I have never been more thankful for someone else’s college experience.
lines.zh: : 我从没有像此刻这样,感谢过别人的大学生涯。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t be too thankful. If Rika hadn’t shown up, I was going to dare Imani to kiss you.
lines.zh: : 别急着谢。要不是 Rika 出现,我本来打算大冒险 Imani 亲你。

lines.en: : How lucky I am to be given an alternative more in line with my “tastes.”
lines.zh: : 我多么幸运,拿到了一个更符合我「口味」的替代选项。

lines.en: : Mmf!~
lines.zh: : 姆夫!~

lines.en: : Mm......mnhh!
scene hangoutsesh46
: Oh, she’s good. Thanks for that, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 哦,她很厉害。谢了,Wakana。

lines.en: : You were okay. 6/10. Too much tongue.
lines.zh: : 你还行。6/10。舌头太多。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh47
: Yo, what the fuck?!
lines.zh: : 哟,搞什么?!

lines.en: : Wakana, truth or dare!
lines.zh: : Wakana,真心话或大冒险!

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh48
: I suppose it’s only fair if I take a dare this time after hurting Imani’s pride like that.
lines.zh: : 我刚那样伤了 Imani 的自尊,这次领个大冒险才算公平。

lines.en: : 6/10?! That's it?!
: Poor girl. I could tell from here.
lines.zh: : 可怜的姑娘。我坐这儿都看出来了。

lines.en: : This is why I don’t date girls! They’re too picky!
lines.zh: : 这就是我不和女孩约会的原因!她们太挑剔了!

lines.en: : Okay, okay. Leave Imani alone. She tried.
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦。别揪着 Imani 不放。她尽力了。

lines.en: : Tried?!
lines.zh: : 尽力了?!

lines.en: : Wakana, I dare you to make out with Sensei now!
lines.zh: : Wakana,我大冒险你现在亲 Sensei!

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh49
: Uhh...no.
: Wakana’s got a girlfriend, remember?
lines.zh: : Wakana 有女朋友,记得吗?

lines.en: : Oooooh. Oh, right...Yeah, I forgot about that.
: I still kind of want to see it, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我其实还是想看。

lines.en: : I’d offer to take her place but now I’m just self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 我本可以替她上,但现在我自我意识过剩了。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be the same, though. Can’t you like, feel the tension?
lines.zh: : 那也不会是一样的。你就感觉不到那股张力吗?

lines.en: : There is no tension. What you’re likely sensing is the residual excitement that comes from watching two women kiss.
lines.zh: : 没有张力。你感觉到的,多半是「看两个女人接吻」附赠的余韵兴奋。

lines.en: : It’s just a game, though! Right?
lines.zh: : 可这只是游戏嘛!对吧?

lines.en: : Like...you two can kiss with no strings attached and it’ll be totally cool cause, like...some random girl made you do it.
lines.zh: : 就是说……你们俩亲一亲又不用负责,完全没问题——因为,那个……是随便一个女孩让你们做的。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh50
: Are you going to say something or am I going to be the only one to refute this?
lines.zh: : 你们到底打算说点什么,还是只让我一个人反驳?

lines.en: : I mean...it is just a game. I know you don’t actually feel anything for me.
lines.zh: : 就是说……它确实只是游戏。我知道你对我并没有那种感觉。

lines.en: : Wow, what could have given you that idea?
lines.zh: : 哇,这能怪谁呢?

lines.en: : Are we all in agreement to never tell Wakana’s girlfriend about this? Not like I’d...even be able to tell her when I have no idea what she even looks like in the first place, though.
lines.zh: : 我们是不是都同意,永远不把这件事告诉 Wakana 的女朋友?虽然真让我说,我连她长什么样都不知道。

lines.en: : I mean...my lips are sealed. I wouldn’t want Wakana to get in trouble.
lines.zh: : 就是说……我守口如瓶。我可不想 Wakana 惹麻烦。

lines.en: scene hangoutsesh51
: Is it too late to say choose “truth” instead?
lines.zh: : 现在改口选「真心话」还来得及吗?

lines.en: : A dare’s a dare, Wakana. Don’t just dish it out if you can’t take it.
lines.zh: : 大冒险就是大冒险,Wakana。自己不敢接,就别乱发。

lines.en: : Is there some form of penalty I can take instead, then?
lines.zh: : 那有没有别的惩罚形式可以代替?
